digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的模块化能力扩展

repos.name: lobehub/lobehub
repos.description: 🤯 LobeHub - Super-Agents on Your Team. Add super-agents to the chats your team already uses.They take on work by themselves and get better every week.
repos.summary_zh: 把超级智能体直接加入团队现有聊天工具，让它们自主承担工作并每周自我进化

repos.name: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: 精选Claude技能与工具资源库，帮你快速定制AI工作流、告别重复造轮子

repos.name: blader/humanizer
repos.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
repos.summary_zh: 一键抹除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让生成内容读起来更像真人手笔

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: soxoj/maigret
repos.description: 🕵️‍♂️ Collect a dossier on a person by username from 6K websites
repos.summary_zh: 用用户名在6000多个网站搜集个人公开档案的开源情报工具，一键生成人物数字足迹调查报告

repos.name: ModernRelay/omnigraph
repos.description: Object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的对象存储原生图数据库，支持分支与类型化本体，让图数据像代码一样版本化管理

repos.name: yzsind/mydb
repos.description: A high-performance MySQL-compatible database for HTAP and AI agents  Mixed transactional and analytical workloads, with native AI retrieval.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造兼容 MySQL 的 HTAP 数据库，同时支撑事务与分析负载并原生集成 AI 检索

repos.name: phonny40rowle/rag-search
repos.description: A self-hosted retrieval-augmented search API: web search, content extraction, embeddings, and answer generation.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管 RAG 检索增强搜索 API，一站式集成网页搜索、内容提取、向量嵌入与答案生成

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard
repos.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling f
repos.summary_zh: 让 LLM 应用在保持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API 兼容的前提下跨模型跨供应商路由流量，实现灵活选型、基准测试与成本优化

repos.name: shanselman/gputaskman
repos.description: A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs (plus
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台GPU任务管理器，实时监控各进程显存占用与GPU活动，还能洞察LLM模型及KV缓存，兼容NVIDIA、AMD、Intel及华为昇腾

repos.name: RunanywhereAI/trnrt
repos.description: The open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium: NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API. By RunAnywhere.
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AWS Trainium 打造的开源 LLM 推理引擎，用 NKI 大内核实现百万级上下文并兼容 OpenAI API

repos.name: wici-ai/inferssd
repos.description: Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD. Built on llama.cpp.
repos.summary_zh: 突破内存与显存限制，从SSD流式加载MoE专家，让普通设备也能跑超大模型

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调

repos.name: ninetyhe-90/training-explore
repos.description: Interactive explorer for learning how large language models are trained
repos.summary_zh: 用交互式可视化拆解大语言模型训练全流程，让抽象的训练原理变得可动手探索

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可靠决策器

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端

repos.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 无缝接入前端应用的交互协议，统一 Agent 与用户界面的通信标准

repos.name: a2ui-project/a2ui
repos.description: Open-source generative UI framework: agents stream layout data, and apps render it with native components in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 流式输出布局数据、由应用用 React、Flutter、SwiftUI 等原生组件渲染的生成式 UI 框架

repos.name: we-promise/sure
repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.summary_zh: 人人可用的开源个人财务管理应用，用 Ruby 打造并支持社区共建

repos.name: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码助手实时掌握最新 Web 最佳实践的 TypeScript 指南库，解决 AI 编码知识过时问题

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: openai/whisper
repos.description: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
repos.summary_zh: OpenAI 开源的大规模弱监督语音识别模型，多语言高鲁棒性且开箱即用

repos.name: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
repos.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decisi

repos.name: astral-sh/ruff
repos.description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 代码检查与格式化工具，比传统工具快数十倍，一站式替代 Flake8、Black 等

repos.name: block/buzz
repos.description: A hive mind communication platform
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的去中心化蜂群思维通信平台，让多个 AI 智能体像蜂群一样共享上下文协同决策

papers.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching

papers.summary_zh: 提出温度匹配的轻量监督微调方法，仅需少量数据即可缓解过拟合，实现数据高效的语言模型后训练

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
papers.abstract: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervise

papers.title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition

papers.abstract: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapt

papers.title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated c
papers.summary_zh: 提出检索增强的通用医学图像分割校正框架，通过检索相似病例先验实现跨解剖结构残差误差自动修正，显著提升分割精度

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a b
papers.summary_zh: 提出让LLM智能体自主设计自我改进策略的元学习框架，无需人工指定优化方式，在多个基准上超越人工设计方法且性能提升显著

papers.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning an

papers.title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency

papers.summary_zh: 提出面向混合视觉语言模型的低延迟流式推理框架Spool，通过复用循环状态缓存实现有界窗口视频的即时问答

papers.title: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
papers.abstract: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognit

papers.abstract: In this paper, we study a class of constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems. In many practical applications, all or some of the constraints are hard constraints that represent imperative re
papers.summary_zh: 提出非精确随机方差缩减梯度法求解带硬约束的凸有限和优化问题，在保证约束近似满足的同时实现高效收敛

papers.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
papers.abstract: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statis

papers.title: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
papers.abstract: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026,
